That's the other half working just how I hoped. Typing "florence" when it's brand-new gave me a clear "Create new tag" choice, it stuck to the bookmark, and then when I started the next save and typed "flo" it was sitting right there as an existing suggestion — so I won't keep re-inventing it. 

Keeping new tags in lowercase is fine by me; that's exactly the kind of tidiness that stops me ending up with "Florence" and "florence" as two separate things. And asking me to actually pick "Create new tag" rather than silently making one the instant I type feels right — I'd rather say so on purpose.

Tagging's good. What's next?
